sv.title: L: Våld i skolan ska leda till omplacering
sv.summary: Liberalerna vill att våld i skolan i högre grad ska leda till omplacering av elever. Det säger partiledaren Simona Mohamsson på en pressträff.

en.title: L: Violence in schools should lead to reassignment
en.summary: The Liberals want violence in schools to more often lead to students being reassigned. This is according to party leader Simona Mohamsson at a press conference.
